records.text: An unnamed email sender reported seeing and photographing Tyler Robinson’s car in his parents’ driveway days after he reportedly turned himself in; Owens says she misplaced the photos.
records.speaker: Email photo sender reporting Tyler Robinson car in driveway (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: And I do want to say this because I was so driven crazy by an email that I couldn't find early on in the investigation. Someone sent me an email. ... They said that they had been walking down the street of Tyler Robinson's parents and this was days after Tyler Robinson had quote unquote turned himself in and they saw his car and they sent me multiple photos of Tyler Robinson's car sitting in the driveway and I have. ... Have misplaced those photos. So if you have other photos of Tyler Robinson's car, clear photos, maybe you were walking through the neighborhood in those early days, please resend them to us, moretips at candaceowens.com. I would love to just get, like, super clear exclusive photos of Tyler (Tyler Robinson)'s car, moretips at candaceowens.com. Okay, moving on.
